name: KiCad EDA
description: Full-featured GPL cross-platform suite for schematic capture, PCB layout, 3D viewing and Gerber output with no feature limits.

name: LibrePCB
description: Beginner-friendly GPL schematic and PCB editor with a strongly curated, unified part library system.

name: Horizon EDA
description: GPL EDA package with a pool-based part library and a fast interactive router, aimed at professional workflows.

name: Fritzing (source code)
description: Breadboard-to-PCB tool whose source is GPLv3 and free to build, but official ready-made installers on fritzing.org require a payment (about $12 personal).

name: gEDA Project
description: Long-running GPL suite of schematic, netlist and PCB tools for Linux/Unix users.

name: pcb-rnd
description: Actively maintained GPL modular PCB editor descended from gEDA PCB, with many import/export formats.

name: FreeCAD
description: LGPL parametric 3D CAD for designing enclosures and checking mechanical fit around PCBs.

name: KiCad StepUp (FreeCAD workbench)
description: FreeCAD workbench that syncs KiCad board outlines and 3D models to STEP for ECAD-MCAD collaboration.

name: atopile
description: MIT-licensed language and compiler for describing circuits as code, with reusable modules that build KiCad layouts.

name: SKiDL
description: Python library to describe circuit netlists in code and export them to KiCad and other tools.

name: tscircuit
description: MIT-licensed TypeScript/React framework for designing schematics and PCBs as code with autorouting and Gerber export.

name: InteractiveHtmlBom
description: KiCad plugin that generates an interactive HTML BOM highlighting each part on the board for hand assembly.

name: KiBot
description: Automates KiCad fabrication outputs (Gerbers, BOMs, PDFs, 3D renders) from a single YAML config, CI-friendly.

name: KiCanvas
description: MIT-licensed in-browser viewer for KiCad schematics and boards, handy for sharing designs from GitHub.

name: KiKit
description: KiCad toolkit for panelization, fab-ready output and multi-board projects.

name: PcbDraw
description: Converts KiCad boards into clean 2D drawings and pinout diagrams for documentation.

name: kicad-jlcpcb-tools
description: KiCad plugin to assign LCSC parts and produce JLCPCB-ready BOM and placement files.

name: Import-LIB-KiCad-Plugin
description: KiCad plugin that imports downloaded symbol/footprint ZIPs from part-library sites in one step.

name: pcb2blender
description: Exports KiCad boards to Blender for photorealistic renders, useful for content creation.

name: Freerouting
description: GPL autorouter that works with KiCad and other EDA tools via Specctra DSN files.

name: gerbv
description: GPL Gerber and Excellon drill file viewer for checking fabrication outputs before ordering.

name: tracespace
description: Open-source in-browser Gerber viewer that renders board previews from your fab files.

name: ngspice
description: Open-source SPICE circuit simulator, integrated into KiCad's schematic editor.

name: Qucs-S
description: GPL circuit simulation GUI using ngspice/Xyce backends, good for RF and analog checks.

name: Saturn PCB Toolkit
description: Freeware Windows calculator suite for trace current (IPC-2152), via current, impedance, crosstalk and more.

name: Sierra Circuits PCB Tools
description: Free online calculators for impedance, trace width, via design and stack-ups from a PCB fab house.

name: JLCPCB Impedance Calculator
description: Free online controlled-impedance calculator using JLCPCB's real stack-ups.

name: KiCad Official Symbol Library
description: Official CC-BY-SA KiCad schematic symbol library maintained by the KiCad librarians.

name: KiCad Official Footprint Library
description: Official KiCad footprint library following the KiCad Library Conventions.

name: KiCad Official 3D Models
description: Official STEP/WRL 3D models matching KiCad footprints for 3D views and MCAD export.

name: SparkFun KiCad Libraries
description: SparkFun's open KiCad symbols and footprints for parts used across their open-hardware boards.

name: Digi-Key KiCad Library
description: Atomic KiCad symbol/footprint library tied to Digi-Key part numbers.

name: Espressif KiCad Libraries
description: Official Espressif KiCad symbols, footprints and 3D models for ESP32 chips and modules.

name: Fritzing Parts
description: CC-BY-SA core parts library used by Fritzing.

name: PCB Cupid – KiCad for Beginners
description: Free step-by-step online KiCad lessons from schematic to layout for beginners.

name: KiCad Documentation
description: Official KiCad manuals for every editor and tool, free and openly licensed.

name: Getting Started in KiCad
description: Official KiCad tutorial that walks through a complete first board from schematic to Gerbers.

name: Phil's Lab
description: In-depth KiCad and mixed-signal hardware design tutorials, from STM32 boards to high-speed layout.

name: Robert Feranec
description: Free PCB layout, high-speed design and expert interview videos with designers like Rick Hartley.

name: EEVblog
description: Dave Jones' electronics engineering videos covering design, debugging, teardowns and PCB tips.

name: Contextual Electronics (YouTube)
description: Free KiCad walkthroughs and hardware design streams by Chris Gammell (the paid membership site is separate).

name: Zach Peterson
description: Free videos on PCB layout, signal integrity, EMI and design-for-manufacturing.

name: Sierra Circuits PCB Design Guides
description: Free downloadable eBooks on DFM, HDI, high-speed, stack-up, impedance and EMI design (email form).

name: Sierra Circuits Knowledge Base
description: Free articles on layout rules, DFM/DFA mistakes and KiCad guides from a PCB fab house.

name: MIT OCW 6.002 Circuits and Electronics
description: Free CC-licensed MIT circuits course giving the theory behind PCB-level design.

name: Lessons in Electric Circuits
description: Free openly licensed textbook series on DC, AC, semiconductors and digital circuits.

name: Hardware Design with RP2040
description: Free Raspberry Pi guide walking through a minimal RP2040 board design with KiCad files.

name: KiCad Forum
description: Official KiCad community forum for layout questions, library help and design reviews.

name: EEVblog Forum
description: Large free engineering forum with dedicated PCB/EDA and project sections.

name: r/PrintedCircuitBoard
description: Reddit community for free schematic and layout reviews before you order boards.

name: awesome-electronics
description: Curated list of open-source EDA, simulation, libraries and learning resources for electronics engineers.

name: awesome-kicad
description: Curated list of KiCad plugins, libraries, scripts and resources.

name: Hack Club Hackpad
description: Beginner open-hardware project: design your own macropad PCB in KiCad with guided docs.

name: Hack Club OnBoard
description: Repository of student-designed open PCB projects with guides for designing a first board.

name: Corne Keyboard (crkbd)
description: Open-source split keyboard with full KiCad PCB files, a popular intermediate build.

name: Ploopy Classic Trackball
description: Open-hardware trackball with KiCad PCB, 3D-printable case and firmware.

name: LumenPnP
description: Open-source desktop pick-and-place machine with PCBs, mechanical CAD and docs.

name: HackRF One
description: Open-source software-defined radio with complete KiCad hardware design files, an advanced RF reference.

name: OSHWA Certified Projects
description: Directory of certified open-source hardware projects with links to their design files.

name: Hackaday.io
description: Free platform with thousands of documented hardware builds for project ideas and design files.
